title: Samp and beans with chakalaka
summary: Umngqusho, the classic. Filling and cheap.
steps: Use cooked samp and beans: tinned, or cooked ahead. Dry samp and beans need soaking overnight and 2 to 3 hours of simmering, so cook a big batch and freeze portions.
Warm the samp and beans in a pot with a splash of water and a pinch of salt for 5 minutes, stirring.
For the chakalaka, grate the carrot and chop the onion, pepper and tomato. Fry the onion, carrot and pepper in the oil over medium heat with a pinch of curry powder for 5 minutes.
Add the tomato and baked beans, simmer for 5 minutes and season.
Serve the chakalaka over the samp and beans.
